benchmarks.note: Candidate basis discovery on a small triangle-with-tail graph (4 vertices, 4 edges). Dominated by maximal_cliques enumeration and recursive subclique construction.
NNLS-like projection of edge weights onto the candidate basis (2 cliques) for 1000 iterations. Each iteration scans all cliques and their edge pairs, updating residuals.

Full graphlets decomposition (basis discovery + 1000-iteration projection) on a 20-vertex dense ring graph. The basis discovery dominates, involving recursive clique enumeration at multiple weight thresholds.
